caption: The drawing depicts a statuette of a standing woman, shown in profile from the left side. She has a light skin tone and black hair that is mostly covered by a long, black cloak adorned with a line of circular decorations running down the edge. The woman is dressed in a red robe with long sleeves, with her hands held together in a prayer position at chest level. Around her neck is a yellow necklace or collar. At the bottom of her robe stands a small child figure with a pale face, also in red clothing with green wings or cloak, and one hand raised. The statuette rests on a light brown, rectangular wooden base. The entire scene is rendered against a plain, off-white background, with no additional objects present. The artist's signature and the year "1981" appear in green text at the lower right.
title: Our Lady of Guadalupe (Bulto)
